title: checkin_resource: enforce roll-call list document bound vs PAYLOAD_MAX
description: Bead project-LICHEN-worker6-y9pi added a BUILD_ASSERT bounding the {"checkins":[...]} list document (MAX_CHECKINS x LICHEN_CHECKIN_ENTRY_CBOR_MAX + wrapper <= CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN_PAYLOAD_MAX) in checkin_resource.c. The same gap exists for the {"rollcalls":[...]} list and per-roll-call 18.6.3 status documents: a worst-case status doc (id + started + timeout + 32 responded tracks + 32 missing tracks) is roughly 4-5 KB, so with CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN_MAX_ROLLCALLS > 1 the worst-case list document can exceed even the 16384 Kconfig range maximum; lichen_rollcall_list_encode returns BUFFER_TOO_SMALL and the GET handler degrades to 5.00 at runtime with no build-time warning. Options: a second BUILD_ASSERT with a documented LICHEN_ROLLCALL_STATUS worst-case macro (like LICHEN_CHECKIN_ENTRY_CBOR_MAX) plus Kconfig range/help sizing, or a documented runtime clamp. Keep the checkin_resource twister suite compiling (its MAX_ROLLCALLS=2). Discovered while sizing PAYLOAD_MAX for y9pi.
